// Last time step of an active clock/reset edge per domain (-1 = none seen yet)
  longint signed t_edge_mst = -1;
  longint signed t_edge_slv = -1;

  always @(posedge i_clk_mst or negedge i_rst_n_mst) t_edge_mst = longint'($time);
  always @(posedge i_clk_slv or negedge i_rst_n_slv) t_edge_slv = longint'($time);

  // Per-signal change monitors: a change outside the own edge time step, or a
  // second change within the same time step, increments the violation counter.
`define NNC_CHG_MON(SIG, LT, VC, EDT) \
  longint signed LT = -1; \
  int unsigned VC = 0; \
  always @(SIG) begin \
    if (EDT >= 0) begin \
      if ((EDT != longint'($time)) || (LT == longint'($time))) VC = VC + 1; \
    end \
    LT = longint'($time); \
  end

  `NNC_CHG_MON(o_apb_pready,  lt_m0, vc_m0, t_edge_mst)
  `NNC_CHG_MON(o_apb_pslverr, lt_m1, vc_m1, t_edge_mst)
  `NNC_CHG_MON(o_apb_prdata,  lt_m2, vc_m2, t_edge_mst)
  `NNC_CHG_MON(o_apb_pruser,  lt_m3, vc_m3, t_edge_mst)
  `NNC_CHG_MON(o_apb_pbuser,  lt_m4, vc_m4, t_edge_mst)

  `NNC_CHG_MON(o_apb_psel,    lt_s0, vc_s0, t_edge_slv)
  `NNC_CHG_MON(o_apb_penable, lt_s1, vc_s1, t_edge_slv)
  `NNC_CHG_MON(o_apb_pwrite,  lt_s2, vc_s2, t_edge_slv)
  `NNC_CHG_MON(o_apb_paddr,   lt_s3, vc_s3, t_edge_slv)
  `NNC_CHG_MON(o_apb_pprot,   lt_s4, vc_s4, t_edge_slv)
  `NNC_CHG_MON(o_apb_pstrb,   lt_s5, vc_s5, t_edge_slv)
  `NNC_CHG_MON(o_apb_pwdata,  lt_s6, vc_s6, t_edge_slv)
  `NNC_CHG_MON(o_apb_pwakeup, lt_s7, vc_s7, t_edge_slv)
  `NNC_CHG_MON(o_apb_pauser,  lt_s8, vc_s8, t_edge_slv)
  `NNC_CHG_MON(o_apb_pwuser,  lt_s9, vc_s9, t_edge_slv)

  `undef NNC_CHG_MON

  wire [31:0] viol_total = vc_m0 + vc_m1 + vc_m2 + vc_m3 + vc_m4
                         + vc_s0 + vc_s1 + vc_s2 + vc_s3 + vc_s4
                         + vc_s5 + vc_s6 + vc_s7 + vc_s8 + vc_s9;

  // CHK-002: Outputs change only at their own clock edge or on reset assertion (AB2-3-21, AB2-20.2-06)
  a_CHK_002: assert property (@(posedge i_clk_mst) disable iff (!i_rst_n_mst) 1'b1 |-> $stable(viol_total))
    else begin fails_CHK_002++; $display("NNC_FAIL CHK-002 @%0t", $time); end
  always_ff @(posedge i_clk_mst) if (!(!i_rst_n_mst) && (1'b1)) hits_CHK_002 <= hits_CHK_002 + 1;
notes: The Verilator error is in the header, not the body: `parameter int LPARA_STRB_W = Derived` (and LPARA_REQ_W / LPARA_RESP_W) use the undefined identifier `Derived`. The header must define them, e.g. LPARA_STRB_W = PARA_APBCDC_DATA_W/8. The body is unchanged and only references the parameter names. The body was not run through Verilator. A possible weakness: a reset-edge output change could be ordered before the edge-time update in the same time step, which would give a false violation.
